title: Transistor count doubling time (years)

source.name: Moore's Law doubling cadence, original vs. recent
source.publisher: Gordon E. Moore, 'Cramming more components onto integrated circuits' (Electronics, 1965); widely reported slowdown documented in industry/press analyses (e.g. IEEE Spectrum, Nature) through the 2010s-2020s

notes: Moore's original 1965 observation held a roughly 2-year doubling cadence through the late 20th century. Multiple industry and academic analyses of 2010s-2020s chip generations put the empirical doubling time closer to 3 years as transistors approach atomic-scale limits.
